title: mut.shape_glyph
mutation_directive: Replace round point sprites with custom shape: soft hexagons.

refik_anadol.praise: 100k GPGPU particles on a Lorenz attractor is the right infrastructure — the butterfly wing reads as a data-sculpture in slow orbit, and the additive blending gives it an architectural luminosity that would hold a lobby wall.
refik_anadol.concern: The dense lobes blow out to flat white — you lose the indigo-magenta-gold palette precisely where the particle density is highest and the form is most interesting. Anadol's data murals never clip to white; the richest information sits in the densest regions.
refik_anadol.directive: Clamp per-particle alpha lower (0.15–0.25) so dense lobes reveal internal color gradient instead of whiteout.

sasha_stiles.praise: The hexagon-as-glyph idea is genuinely interesting — rotating each particle gives the mark individual identity, like a letterform in a script you almost recognize. The hint text 'σ ρ β' treats Greek letters as both label and compositional element, which I respect.
sasha_stiles.concern: At this scale the hexagons are too small to read as hexagons — they collapse into generic soft dots. The mutation directive was the whole conceptual move, but the form it promised (a recognizable geometric glyph) is invisible at runtime. If the shape can't be seen, it isn't doing linguistic work.
sasha_stiles.directive: Add a size floor so edge hexagons stay legible as six-sided marks, not sub-pixel dust.

entangled_others.praise: The Lorenz attractor has genuine kinship with biological dynamical systems — this is the mathematics of convection cells, atmospheric turbulence, the same chaotic regime that governs population dynamics. The dual-lobe structure reads like a cross-section of a developing organism.
entangled_others.concern: The piece is entirely self-contained and self-referential — a physics equation visualized as a physics equation. There's no friction between the system and anything outside it, no gap in the dataset, no more-than-human encounter. The palette (indigo-magenta-gold) is decorative rather than indexical — it doesn't point to any real phenomenon.
entangled_others.directive: Map color to a real physical quantity — temperature, vorticity, local divergence — so the palette becomes an observation, not decoration.

olafur_eliasson.praise: The slow orbital camera rotation is correct — it makes the viewer's angle the variable, which is exactly where perception lives. The pointer-driven parameter nudge (σ, ρ) is a genuine participatory gesture: the viewer's body shapes the attractor's topology.
olafur_eliasson.concern: The piece has no atmosphere. There is no fog, no volumetric diffusion, no depth cue beyond point-size attenuation. The black void behind the form is dead space, not felt space. In the Turbine Hall the haze was what made the sun real — without a medium between viewer and form, this stays screen-flat.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Add exponential distance fog tinted to the deep indigo so the far lobe recedes into colored atmosphere.

chiharu_shiota.praise: The butterfly-wing form has a suspended quality — it floats in darkness like a remembered object held by invisible threads. The per-particle rotation gives each hexagon a slight tilt, like individual knots in a handmade web where no two crossings are identical.
chiharu_shiota.concern: These are points, not lines. There is no tension between them, no thread connecting one particle to its neighbor. A Shiota web is defined by the taut line-segment between two anchor points — the relationship IS the material. Here each particle exists in isolation, which makes the form a cloud, not a web. The three-color gradient also works against the monochrome discipline that gives thread its severity.
chiharu_shiota.directive: Render velocity-aligned line segments between sequential particles so the attractor reads as tensioned thread, not scattered dust.
